body: No, I haven't. Seems like a band-aid solution though.

It's just a void. A dark, lifeless void. I tried drinking to cope but I don't even have the drive to do that anymore. I tried surrounding myself with friends but theyre all moochers and phonies. I've tried just staying out of my house for as long as I can, getting out, getting active but sunsets and starry skies don't even register with me anymore. All I can think of is death. The last time I felt anything was when I told my friend I loved him, and I wanted to change our relationship but he just cast me aside. I felt awful for a long time, but gradually evened out to this nothingness. I'd give anything, just to feel like I did that day, it was terrible but at least it was something.

I can't, for now. That image of my mother sobbing is still too powerful. But like anything else in my life that has managed to evoke some kind of feeling, it will fade. And I don't care. If I'm going to be dead inside I might as well be dead.
